articles.title_original: The color of uniformity: Far-red light effects on plant growth
articles.title_cn: 统一的颜色：远红光对植物生长的影响
articles.excerpt_original: Ever wandered through a field of plants and observed how their heights are relatively uniform? In nature, this is partly due to plants' ability to sense their neighbors through light receptors and shade-avoidance responses. When a lower ratio of red to far-red (FR) light is detected due to the presence of neighboring plants, plants elongate their stems to compete for light.
articles.summary_cn: 你是否曾漫步在一片植物田中，注意到它们的身高相对均匀？在自然界中，这部分是由于植物通过光受体和避阴反应感知其邻居的能力。当检测到红光与远红光（FR）的比例较低，这通常是由于邻近植物的存在时，植物会伸长它们的茎来竞争光照。
